description: This Java class acts as an adapter to extract properties from a Vert.x MultiMap object for tracing purposes, implementing the io.opentracing.propagation.TextMap interface.

classes.name: MultiMapExtractAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for extracting tracing properties from a Vert.x MultiMap, implements TextMap interface.

methods.name: MultiMapExtractAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with a MultiMap object, ensuring it's not null.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the MultiMap entries, used for extracting tracing information.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Unsupported operation; this adapter is read-only for extraction purposes.
